## the main element of the boxplot 
## 1.	Median (line inside the box) → central value.
	2.	1st quartile (Q1, 25%) → lower edge of the box.
	3.	3rd quartile (Q3, 75%) → upper edge of the box.
	4.	Whiskers → extreme values not considered outliers.
	•	often defined as Q1 − 1.5×IQR and Q3 + 1.5×IQR (where IQR = Q3 − Q1).
	5.	Outliers → values beyond the whiskers.
	
## Why is a boxplot the starting point of choice in summarizing an unknown distribution? 
a boxplot gives a quick, resistant, and distribution-free summary of central tendency, spread, and outliers — making it the best first step before more advanced statistical analysis.
